value.label: CPI Inflation
value.insight: Headline CPI incl food & energy · hist avg ~3%
value.sig: → Above avg but decelerating -- progress toward 2% but not there yet

value.label: Core CPI
value.insight: CPI ex food/energy · Fed watches this · avg ~2.5%
value.sig: ⚠️ Re-heating -- service sector inflation erodes real returns and PE expansion

value.label: PCE Inflation
value.insight: Fed preferred gauge (broader than CPI) · avg ~2.2%
value.sig: ⚠️ Fed's own preferred gauge well above target -- gap between Wall St optimism and reality

value.label: Core PCE
value.insight: THE key number · Fed 2% target · >3% = rates stay high
value.sig: ⚠️ Re-accelerating at 65% above Fed target -- hike risk rising, PE compression ahead

value.label: 10Y Treasury
value.insight: Risk-free rate · rising compresses P/E multiples · avg ~4%
value.sig: ⚠️ Approaching levels where bonds compete with equities on yield -- watch spread compression

value.label: 2Y Treasury
value.insight: Fed expectations proxy · rising = no rate cuts priced in
value.sig: ⚠️ Higher 2Y locks in restrictive financial conditions -- reduces room for P/E expansion

value.label: Yield Curve (10Y-2Y)
value.sig: → Nearly flat -- disinversion underway but not yet a steepening growth signal; watch direction

value.label: Fed Funds Rate
value.insight: Cost of borrowing · cutting = tailwind for equities
value.sig: → On hold -- Fed is watching; next move direction matters more than current level

value.label: HY Credit Spread
value.sig: → Tight spreads confirm equity calm is credit-supported -- watch for any widening as an early warning

value.label: Unemployment
value.insight: Labor health · rising = consumer risk · hist avg ~5.7%
value.sig: → Near historical norm -- labor not a swing factor for macro direction today

value.label: WTI Crude Oil
value.insight: Energy price · >$85 = inflation pressure & input cost risk
value.sig: ⚠️ Above $100 and rising -- stagflation risk: energy tax on consumers, input cost spike for industry

value.label: Gold Price
value.insight: Fear/inflation hedge · rising+lowVIX = stealth fear signal
value.sig: → Gold surging +20% yr -- real rates concern or dollar debasement fear; watch DXY correlation

value.label: US Dollar (DXY)
value.insight: Dollar strength · weak dollar = tailwind for intl ADRs (EQNR,PBR,SNY etc)
value.sig: → Dollar softening -- gradually improving backdrop for international ADR positions

value.label: Consumer Sentiment
value.insight: U of Michigan 0-100 · avg ~75 · <60 = consumer stress
value.sig: → Below-average sentiment -- consumer cautious but not collapsing; watch for inflection

value.label: Shiller CAPE (US)
value.insight: Cyclically Adj PE · 10yr smoothed · hist avg 17x · ~41 = 2nd highest ever
value.sig: ⚠️ 2.4x the 145yr avg -- only dot-com peak (44x) was higher; 10yr forward returns historically near zero from this level

value.label: Fear
value.signal: Pessimism elevated -- watch for entry setups
